en: Bye. Be nice to folks, alright? Makes a difference in our situation.
See ya. Keep a low profile, alright?
Take care, Brother-in-Scavenge.
Please take care, Returner. It's tough out there.
I've done what you asked...
I'm done with the request.
Took care of that job...
Been having a problem...
Might need some diplomatic help.
Think I've made some enemies.
Afraid I need some help.
Folks are attacking me on sight...
Time for a chat?
Got some questions.
Can we talk?
We Never Give Without Taking.
Got a few trinkets you might want.
Alright, let's trade. Backpack's not just for show.
I've got stuff to trade.
Let me look at what you've got.
Do you have anything to trade?
Staying out of trouble, Returner?
Returner?! Glad you're alive... It's Raisa, we've partnered before. Came here to help with... All this.
Hello, Brother-in-Scavenge.
Hey, Returner. We See Death In Comfort.

Best way I've found so far is to show some service... You take care of a job for whoever's shooting at you on sight, I'll show them your results, put in a good word, and maybe you'll be back in their good graces.
How can you help?
Good. Let me see what I've got for you, then...
I'll do whatever you say.
I have to kill a bunch of those? They're tough.
So if I deal with them...
No complainin', now. I could take them, and that's how I know you can, too.
I've marked their usual spot on your map. Please do this nice and quiet, alright? Remember, everyone's suspicious of us Vultures right now. To put it mildly.
I think I know what you can do to get on pretty much anyone's good graces: Mother Moras. Those freakin' rat moms are infesting all of Zalesye with their offspring...
If you take care of them, I'll sing your praises to my contacts, and this should help them treat you with at least some neutrality.
Seems you've made some enemies, huh. I've been trying to smooth things over 'tween us Vultures and other factions. I think I can help.
Not sure that'll work. Need to think on it.
Sounds simple enough. I'm in.
It's not foolproof, but it needs to be done, Returner. For the other Vultures in hiding, as well.

You're in trouble, huh? I'll be brief. Got a job here from the folks you've wronged; just take care of it and I'll pitch them on how they shouldn't shoot you on sight. Don't worry; I'm good at that part.
Thanks. Here's what that earned ya, besides the peace 'n quiet.
Our Brothers- and Sisters-in-Scavenge...
From the first shots to all this rubble wasn't even a whole hour...
What the hell happened...?
What a loss, right? I wonder if this means more Doubles outings, or if that'll be even rarer.
About the attack...
I don't blame you for being at a loss. Funnily enough, now I know what to do with myself better than ever before.
Oh, Returner... It's all gone. Some geared-up soldiers came out of nowhere and shot everyone, placed bombs, started fires.
How can I start over? This is too much...
Our colleagues put up a fight, though; there's a few foreign soldier corpses around, if you care to pick 'em. I can't be bothered...
No, not the usual. Our folk managed to kill a couple of 'em, see over there? Western-lookin'. Plus, I caught a glimpse of one, too. Just... Got too scared to get closer...
No. Was in Dubravka, gettin' a meal, when we heard the shooting. They sent some Palatines to investigate, I tagged along...
Foreign soldiers? Not Bandits?
Listen, man. Dying in Zalesye ain't too bad if the alternative is a suicide mission in that fucking highway.
Did you see how it went down?
By the time I got here... Everyone was dead. Our Brothers- and Sisters-in-Scavenge, killed in their homes by those fuckin' foreign soldiers...
My shack's thrashed. I've lost everything.
About something else...
I'm something of a diplomat. It's why I'm sticking around. No one's gonna stand up for us Vultures but ourselves, not if this shit starts going down in other places as well...
Help how...?
Why the hell did they do it?
I'm sorry to hear that, Returner. I know you've been gunnin' for the RO-29 for a while, huh? This will set you back...
Us Vultures are loners, sure... But surviving the road East? That's not some shit you do on your own.
Can't help much with that, but if folks here start giving you attitude on account of this violence, I can help make amends.
Think I'll die in Zalesye.
Right? What was the point? Didn't even loot anything, far as I can tell. Just burned it all down.
About the coming days...
... Anyone you knew?
... No one's gonna trust us.
And we won't get any odd jobs or requests, either. Imagine having to trade Cores and bear claws every single day just to get by?
More than usual. I've heard there's been lynchings in Zalesye before, of scavs just like us. Don't wanna play around with that.
Well, I'm not keen on picking at these burned corpses, but... There's bound to be someone I knew in there.
I'm not sure how to feel, a lot of these people were basically strangers, that's how our group works. But now... Can't help but think I should've gotten to know 'em better.
Does this mean we're all being hunted?
I don't know, but I think we should assume so. For the time being, I'll just focus on helping our reputation survive this – so we can keep trading, keep getting clients. Otherwise...
... We're all fucked.
No, no, I'm just... Mulling things over. Think I'll stick around, keep an eye out for those soldiers, and try to help other Vultures being persecuted.
No one gets past the RO-29, Returner. And the other directions ain't much better, neither. That's just how it is... We're all stuck. This is what we got.
Yeah, well. There's always other factions to join...
I feel you, really. My shack is wrecked, too. But as much as Zalesye and the Dola beat the crap out of us, we know it inside and out. So we'll pick ourselves up, bit by bit.
Until it's our turn to get jumped, apparently.
If there's one thing about the Rada which isn't complete horseshit, it's how they help each other out when there's need.
Why are you still here? Searching for something?
But this? This full-blown military-lookin' raid, this Gunners-n-Palatines-type shit? I don't get it. That's not... Us.
About something else...
Rack up a kill count and some loot, always thinking: "This is just another Scavenge". Back on our feet in no time.
No idea how to start over, now.
Can't deny this has fucked up the usual flow of things. We're supposed to be taken by the wasteland, by the Dola. Die to a Bandit or a Mutant, to gettin' greedy.
That's exactly the cycle I want out of.
I'll get their supplies.
Glad to hear it.
Not sure I need their support.
They're important to a lot of Commonfolk. You need to be mindful of those things now...
Let me do something else first.
Not sure you should delay this, but...
Good.
Can't have them think I'm heartless.
I'll do it. Hope they see I'm a hero.
Whose superpower is getting his rifle jammed and dying to a rat.
No way. Protecting the weak is not my job.
All the violence around you, getting shot, being hunted. Not enough to create some empathy?
Let me take care of some other problems first.
Careful, Returner. The Commonfolk seem weak, but they have lynched one of us before.
I'm a hero now.
Whatever. Just don't want more trouble.
Sure, I'll find some scriptures.
You'll walk out of this a true believer, I bet.
Not sure I'm up for spreading the gospel.
They're not gonna stick to sermons if you piss 'em off too much.
Not feeling this one. Any other ideas?
None for the Acolytes, no...
Wasn't easy getting those.
Just hope they'll keep treating my wounds.
Sounds right up my alley.
I would hope so. Don't let them come to hate you, man.
No. Rather deal with this some other way.
If you don't want my help, it's OK. I just hope you know what you're doing.
I'd rather talk about a different problem.
You like toying around with them geeks, huh? That's a dangerous game.
Worth a shot long as they don't get violent.
Can't picture any one of them liking any one of us.
Hurts to find that and not keep it, but fine.
One small sacrifice for a whole lotta peace of mind.
Not about to give up a weapon.
And what if you're forced to use it against them? Would that be worth it?
I'll take care of something else for now.
... Then stay clear of Arcadia, of Dubravka, of the Farms, of the Bastion...
Easy come, easy go. Just hope they stop shooting at me.
It was pretty hard to get. Almost changing my mind, here.
Sounds dangerous, but worth the risk...
Yes. Especially if you want to cross one of the routes they control.
Not about to enter one firefight to avoid another...
You sure? Remember, these are thugs. They'll try and get the drop on you. Dirty tactics...
I'll let them hate me a bit longer.
I understand wanting to stick it to them. But we need as many allies as we can find right now, Returner.
Don't need anything from them.
I wouldn't want them to.
Never thought I'd be helping their rituals.
You'll be dancing and chanting in no time – if this goes well.
Refuse to mess with those creatures.
They're still human... I think. Some of them, at least. Those are the ones you have to win over...
They're not a threat. What else can I work on?
Seriously? I've seen what the more... Advanced ones can do to some poor vagrant. Keep your wits about you, man.
Don't feel great doing this.
Staying far away from those freaks from now on.
Sure. Wasn't thinking straight.
Just go grab the items, man.
You wouldn't understand.
Of course I fucking would. What makes you so special? We're in the same boat.
I'll mull on that some more, then.
I can't believe this. You...
Thank you...
Whatever you say.
Doesn't look like I can help with anything.
Unless you have to make amends with someone, I got nothing for ya.
Seems you don't need my help.
Need to make amends with a faction.
There's a faction giving me trouble...
Got on the wrong side of some people...
Snugglin' up to the Rada shouldn't be too difficult; they're simple folk. Give them some food or supplies without askin' for much in return, and they'll warm up to you quick.
Another fall-out with the Rada, huh? Shouldn't be too much trouble. They've been putting out orders for some food, supplies, etcetera. Be their gracious donor and I'll put in a good word.
Got Rada trouble? I'm sure they're quick to forgive, y'know. Try findin' some supplies for them... Food, bandages and such. They're always in dire need of that stuff.
Good work; this should help me convince them you're not against the future of Zalesye, and all that.
Good! This will do. They should be able to forgive you when they see the poorer folk getting a meal out of your work.
Commonfolk never really trusted us, but nowadays it's worse than ever... Say, why don't you take care of a few Mutants 'round their dwellings, see if that don't help smooth things over?
Oh Returner, how could you mess with the Commonfolk? Get it together, man, they're the most vulnerable people out there. Go take care of some Mutants, and I'll see what I can do for ya.

You hurt them? Shame on you, man...! They're too vulnerable already. You can make up to them by taking care of some of the dangers they face on the daily, just like we do, but without the means for self-defense.
I'm glad you're back safe. The people will feel safer now, as well.
Seems you've made the roads safer for the common man. Good job, Returner.
Alright, if I know one thing about those Acolytes, it's how they value their rituals... Why don't you see if you can find some old copies of their scriptures? They will surely appreciate that.
Damn, even Acolytes are aggressive towards you now? Well, not like it's difficult for them to reject our ways... Say, go find some copies of their religious texts, that should butter 'em up.

You messed with the cult, huh? Well, I guess you're already fucked even without the divine interference. Anyway, just find them some of the scriptures they're so attached to; forgiveness is a big thing in their beliefs, I think.
Done it? Good, good. I'll go have a chat with one of them soon. Should help your situation!
Nicely done, Returner. They'll surely appreciate the extra material. Was it too hard to find?
Hmm. Might be tough, but I'll try to talk them into forgiving whatever you did. Should take something to bargain with, though – maybe you can salvage some electrical components...

Oh, no good falling out with them lab coats. Way too important for us as traders, right? But it's alright; for all their intellect and arrogance, they're a bit predictable. Just salvage these for 'em.

You've stepped on some pretty important toes now, man. Can't forget how much we depend on those scientist types. But it's okay, I know what types of things they'll want. Just find some of these components and I'll smooth things over for ya.
These parts look good to me. I'm no expert, but I should be able to sweet-talk those Mechanists for you, make them... Less grumpy.
Nice, these parts are lookin' good. Bet I can convince them to hate you a little bit less, now.
Soldiers are a dangerous bunch to mess around with. You'll want 'em on your good side, Returner. Maybe I'm bein' shallow, but guns and ammo seem as fine a peace offering as any.
You pissed off the big guys with the big guns? What are ya, a Gunner double-agent? Sheesh, man. Go find them some new toys, and plenty of ammo. I'll try to convince them to forgive you.

Messed with the Palatines, huh? I understand how they're kinda easy to knock heads with. But they run security on a lot of spots, so tell you what – find a few new toys for them, I'll smooth things over.
This is some fine gear. Passin' it down will hurt me as much as it hurts you.
Wow, this is good stuff. Hope you didn't mess with a different faction just for this.
I suppose I understand why you wouldn't wanna be on the Gunner's bad side... Especially if you've been going up the Dola Oblast. Thankfully, there's some Bandits they'd like to see gone...
Gunners? Those psychos only really care about what you can do for them, so they should be quick to forgive you if you take care of some competition, y'know? Just as a favor, of course.

Picked a fight with the gangsters? That's not too bad, honestly. They probably beat each other up all the time. Just take care of a few Bandits and I'll let them know you've been puttin' in some service.
So you wiped out an entire Bandit squad? If you hadn't messed with them earlier, Gunners might be willing to take you in.
I see you racked up some bodies. I'll let the Gunners know they have been done a favor. Maybe they'll return it.
Mist-worshippers, that's a bigger threat than you'd think. Plus, we don't hire them now and again, our routes get covered with Mist. Maybe some valuable Mutant parts will please them?
If you don't wanna get slashed to pieces by the corpse-bearers, maybe gather a few Mutant parts, valuable ones, y'know. We'll treat it as an offering, and try to make peace from there.
Mudlarks are a bit too psycho to keep them on your bad side for long... Best to patch things up before they jump you on some random road. An offering of Mutant parts should appease them.
Nice find. I'll meet with one of them shortly, should be able to prop you up in their eyes...
Good find, Returner. I'll try to locate a younger, speaking Mudlark; hopefully they spread the news.
Can't believe you managed to piss off our Brothers- and Sisters-in-Scavenge, Returner. We Have But Tongue and Fangs. I'm not fucking around: you pay with your gear.
Don't know if I should help... How could you treat your colleagues so poorly? Aren't things hard enough for us right now, Returner?... Part with some sweet gear, 'n maybe we'll make amends.

That ain't nice, Returner. You should take better care of the few of us who're left. Despite our way of life, we're still in a situation where we gotta stick together. It'll take some nice gear to work this out, alright?
Done? Good. I'll cool down on this and talk to the others when they come up here. Please go, now.
Good stuff. We'll make good use of it, defending against those foreigners. Take care.
I'll handle it.
I appreciate the help. Hope you appreciate the work...
Gotta think about it.
Well, having the luxury of turning down a job is a good thing.
Don't you have anything else?
Glad to help, Raisa.
Take care.
I'll kill them for you.
Appreciate it, Brother. But don't be too hasty about it.
Let me think about it.
They're not gonna give us time to think, Brother.
Any other requests?
It went well.
I'll be back for more.
So there’s been more Mutant activity 'round here recently, since most of us Vultures who used to deal with them are gone… We’ll have to step up, keep those pests under control. You down?
A few dangerous Mutants have been attacking too close to the Mire… What with the shortage of Vultures to deal with them naturally, y’know. Got a reward for you if you kill a few of 'em.
Awesome job, Brother. Glad you're in one piece, too. Hope this is enough pay.
You did great! I know it's tough for us right now, but see?, we can get by... If we keep doin' what we always do.
Not usually how I do things, but… Need you to kill a Bandit squad for me, Returner. They’re operating around here, killing Commonfolk who'd usually be protected by Vultures. You down?
There’s a squad of Bandits who’s been going around this region picking off Commonfolk and Acolytes. They’re taking advantage of the Villa massacre to act more boldly. Let’s correct them.
Glad you took care of those bastards, Brother. Hope they didn't give you too much trouble.
That's great news. Here's your pay – wish I had more to give you, but you know how it's been.
